title: cytisus supinus subsp. austriacus
intro: Cytisus supinus subsp. austriacus, commonly known as Austrian rockrose, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Austrian rockrose include wound healing, anti-anxiety, and cardiovascular protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
